acceptance: The actual Cargo/test-harness process exits zero, with complete raw stdout/stderr and authoritative terminal receipt.
Each of the ten full names appears exactly once with outcome ok in the actual run; the required set equals the executed module set.
The harness reports ten passed, zero failed and zero ignored; no required control is skipped, absent, duplicated, filtered out or replaced.
Both validation_to_lock controls must execute and pass. Their source-controlled helper must retain the reached assertion and exact identity-changed refusal.
Tests outside the selected module may be reported as filtered out; that is not a skipped required control and must not inflate the ten-test result.
Source identity is reverified after every outcome, including error or timeout, and equals the fixed before state.
Any failed, missing or ambiguous result remains failure or UNKNOWN; retain original logs and do not automatically rerun or change assertions.
before_run: Root supplies exact final HEAD and tree and grants execution; verify the designated worktree matches both and is clean.
Run only the existing root-approved source preflight and capture/source-identity logic; record toolchain, exact argv, working directory, timeout and existing selected environment.
Verify selected artifact Git OID/size/SHA equals the reviewed source; inspect any changed Cargo/module boundaries before execution.
Reuse the existing owned Linux component target/cache and capture directories; do not change Cargo.lock, dependencies, compiler flags, cfg, test code, permissions, quota or source.
Confirm the original test roster on the fixed source. A list-only inventory, if used by the existing runner, is not test execution evidence.
evidence_to_capture: ten-name execution/outcome reconciliation and the two new names

proposed_command.profile: ordinary Cargo test profile; no new profile override
proposed_command.timeout_note: Root must choose and record a component-run budget; this proposal does not claim an inherited or original budget.

scope: Ordinary Rust unit tests of bounded local worker artifact reads, including controlled real filesystem mutations at the validation-to-lock boundary.
No run_from_zero_host, Host controller/simulation, benchmark, old protocol, fixture replacement, quota/deadline/worker-count change or performance claim.
This plan and any future pass do not qualify public activation, custody, consensus, full repository semantics or the separate 4-second/16-worker CONFIRMATION_TARGET.
